name: Library Volunteer Program (teens welcome from age 12)
what_you_do: Help organize materials. Help at youth, teen and adult events and special events. Other tasks are the Book Sale Room, genealogy projects and office work. Training is provided.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be at least 12 years old. Volunteers under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the application.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Complete the online volunteer application. After you apply, the Volunteer Coordinator contacts you. This takes a couple of weeks. They set up your orientation. Email volcoor@lclsonline.org. Or call 307.773.7225.
notes: The library also has a Teen Zone page. A background check is required for volunteers age 18 and older.
